## Overview

- Add a shared scene graph for Mermaid and architecture diagrams.
- Add editable PowerPoint export and SVG generation for scene-graph diagrams.
- Improve diagram rendering, themes, documentation, and the bilingual landing site.
- Keep the Canvas Extension, Agent Skills, CLI, and Desktop on the unified 3.3.0 release.

## Compatibility and migration

This release is backward compatible for existing Markdown decks. No migration is required.

| Area | Migration |
| --- | --- |
| Version-pinned installation | Update the pinned tag to `v3.3.0`. |
| Diagram exports | Existing Mermaid and architecture diagrams continue to render; PowerPoint and SVG exports now use the shared scene graph where supported. |
